title: 실버 × 블루
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE standalone photorealistic premium industrial website hero photograph, square 1:1 composition, high resolution. Input reference image is a GEOMETRY AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: choose the large front-left tapered roller bearing cage and depict ONE cage of that same type. Preserve its thin pressed-steel truncated-cone body, two continuous annular rims, evenly spaced slender ribs and rectangular/trapezoidal open windows, empty central bore. This is an EMPTY BEARING CAGE, not an assembled bearing: absolutely no balls, rollers, inner race, outer race, teeth, screws or invented extra components. Preserve credible thin wall thickness and subtle manufacturing texture; satin silver steel, not chrome jewelry, not plastic. The website is Samho Engineering, blue and white, calm and substantial. No people, hands, text, lettering, logo, watermark, layout, borders, collage or inset. Image should have presence and weight, with the cage occupying most of the frame but readable geometry. This is a conceptual promotional photograph based on the supplied component.
Direction: Original recommended direction. One large cage resting naturally on a seamless pale silver/off-white studio surface, photographed from a three-quarter angle slightly above its rim. Entire cage visible occupying 78 percent of the square. Main light broad neutral softbox from upper left, restrained deep-blue reflected light along the right rim and selected ribs only. Strong but soft contact shadow, gentle ivory-to-cool-gray background, crisp rim edges and subtle brushed texture. A sophisticated restrained engineering campaign photo.
